description: Calculate an Instagram post's engagement rate from its likes, comments, saves and shares, as a percentage of followers and optionally of reach, and compare it with rule-of-thumb benchmarks for the account's follower tier. Pure arithmetic; nothing is looked up. Benchmarks are working estimates, not official Instagram figures.

reach.description: Accounts the post reached (optional). When given, the rate by reach is returned as well.

name: instagram_engagement_rate
title: Instagram engagement rate calculator
